headline: BARRICK FALLS 9.7% — NEWMONT PAYS $1.95B FOR FOURMILE RIGHTS; CITI PEGS ASSET AT $10-20B, NORTH AMERICAN IPO NOW CLEARED
snippet: Barrick Mining and Newmont resolved their Nevada Gold Mines joint venture dispute on August 10-11, 2026: Newmont will pay Barrick US$1.95 billion within 30 days, in exchange for which Barrick contributes its Fourmile gold project — expected to produce up to 750,000 ounces annually — into the NGM JV alongside Newmont's Fiberline and Mike developments. The deal clears Newmont's objection to Barrick's planned North American spin-off IPO, targeting a $60B+ valuation and year-end listing. But Barrick stock sank 9.7% on the day because Citi analyst Alexander Hacking pegs Fourmile's standalone value at US$10-20 billion — meaning Barrick received roughly 10-20 cents on the dollar for an asset investors viewed as its most prized internal optionality. Institutional shareholders including Van Eck (Barrick's fourth-largest holder), Mackenzie, and Franklin have actively pushed back on the spinoff plan, arguing the restructuring transfers future upside to new IPO investors at existing shareholders' expense.

headline: GOLIATH GOT SUREBET: 10.32 g/t Au OVER 6m IN NEW 320-METER GOLDEN GATE NE EXPANSION — GOLDEN TRIANGLE BC ZONE REMAINS OPEN
snippet: Goliath Resources (TSX-V: GOT) released August 11, 2026 assay results confirming high-grade gold mineralization within the newly established 320-metre northeast expansion area of its Golden Gate Zone on the 100%-owned Golddigger Property, Golden Triangle, British Columbia. Hole GD-26-424 returned 10.32 g/t gold over 6.00 metres, including 33.80 g/t gold over 1.82 metres — the best intercept yet from within the new expansion footprint first confirmed by the August 10 batch (9.87 g/t over 5.00m, separate hole). The Golden Gate Zone on Goliath's Surebet Discovery now extends 320 metres further northeast than originally delineated and remains open laterally and at depth. Goliath's Surebet Discovery is one of the most active high-grade gold drill stories in BC's Golden Triangle, a district that commands a valuation premium from major gold producers scouting Tier-1 jurisdiction acquisitions. Two consecutive days of high-grade results in the new expansion area signals the program is tracking grade continuity, not isolated intercepts.

headline: 1911 GOLD AUMB OGAMA-ROCKLAND MRE: 712,000 OZ Au AT 6.68 g/t INFERRED — RICE LAKE MANITOBA RESOURCE OPEN, Q4 DRILL PLANNED
snippet: 1911 Gold Corporation (TSXV: AUMB) announced an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for the Ogama-Rockland Gold Project on August 11, 2026, delivering an underground Inferred Resource of 3,314,000 tonnes at 6.68 g/t gold containing 712,000 ounces — calculated at a 2.50 g/t gold economic cut-off and based on Deswik stope optimization. The deposit is located approximately 45 km southeast of 1911 Gold's 100%-owned, fully permitted True North mine and mill complex on the Rice Lake property in southeast Manitoba, providing potential future toll milling optionality without new infrastructure permitting. The resource is open along-strike and down-dip across multiple gold veins; an additional Q4 2026 drill program is planned to test expansion targets. A 6.68 g/t average Inferred grade sits well above the typical resource-stage grade threshold needed to justify underground mining economics at current gold prices above $4,400 per ounce, making Ogama-Rockland one of the higher-grade underground resource-stage projects in the TSX-V junior gold space.

headline: ENDURANCE GOLD EDG: EAGLE ZONE 100m DOWN-DIP EXTENSION — 9.27 g/t Au OVER 6.1m OUTSIDE CURRENT RESOURCE, RELIANCE BC
source_name: The Northern Miner / Endurance Gold Corporation (TSXV: EDG)
snippet: Endurance Gold Corporation (TSXV: EDG) released the second batch of 2026 drill assays from its 100%-owned Reliance Gold Project near Gold Bridge, British Columbia on August 11, 2026, reporting that hole DDH26-135 returned 9.27 g/t gold and 0.36% antimony over 6.1 metres — including 19.40 g/t gold over 1.0 metre — representing a 100-metre down-dip extension of the Eagle Zone 'Feeder Structure' beyond the boundaries of the current 1.45 million ounce Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate. The same hole also intersected 4.33 g/t gold over 7.7 metres as an infill hit within Eagle South. The two-rig, fully funded 2026 program has now completed 7,200 metres in 18 holes, with total drilling expected to exceed 10,000 metres targeting resource expansion at the Eagle, Crown, and Imperial zones. Step-out mineralization of this grade outside the resource envelope is the kind of result that materially expands a resource in the next MRE update.

headline: NICKEL RETREATS TO $16,700 FROM JAN HIGH OF $18,950 — INDONESIA MULLS H2 RKAB QUOTA EXPANSION, BATTERY METALS BID SOFTENS
snippet: LME nickel is trading near $16,700 per tonne, down from its January 2026 peak of $18,950, as reports emerge that Indonesia may grant supplemental RKAB quota allocations to major nickel ore producers in H2 2026 — potentially adding tens of millions of wet metric tonnes to a market already navigating significant supply uncertainty. The 2026 approved quota of 260-270 million wmt was set 30-34% below 2025's 379 million wmt, a reduction that drove the January price spike; supplemental allocations in H2 could push effective supply back toward 320-345 million wmt and weigh on both ore and refined nickel prices. Three scenarios are in focus: large increase (340-360 Mt, bearish for price), moderate (290-320 Mt, neutral), or no increase (260-280 Mt, bullish). For TSX-V and ASX junior nickel developers, the uncertainty around Indonesia's H2 decision is the single most important factor in 2026 project financing discussions — a high-quota outcome makes new nickel development harder to finance, while a tight-quota outcome supports the supply-deficit case Western projects are building their economics on.

headline: SILVER'S SIXTH STRAIGHT DEFICIT WIDENS TO 46.3 MOZ — SOLAR THRIFT SAVES 19% PER PANEL BUT CHINA EXPORT LICENSING TIGHTENS SUPPLY
snippet: The global silver market is heading for its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit in 2026, estimated at 46.3 million ounces — wider than 2025 despite photovoltaic manufacturers reducing silver consumption per panel by approximately 19%. The paradox: while solar thrifting (using less silver per cell via improved pastes and thinner fingers) has cut PV demand to roughly 151 million ounces, global mine supply is contracting faster than industrial demand is falling, with total industrial demand estimated at 650 million ounces against production below 1.01 billion ounces versus global demand of 1.24 billion ounces. China reclassified silver as a strategic material on January 1, 2026, restricting exports to 44 licensed firms — a structural supply constraint that adds a geopolitical premium to the persistent physical deficit. For investors watching the gold-silver ratio compress from 67x toward 66x in the current rally, the silver deficit story provides an independent fundamental driver beyond gold's safe-haven and monetary bid: industrial and geopolitical demand is structurally outpacing mine supply regardless of price.

headline: CAROLINA RUSH TSXV: 2,524 ACRES IN 9 NEW MINERAL LEASES ADDED ADJACENT TO BREWER GOLD-COPPER PROJECT, SOUTH CAROLINA
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Carolina Rush Corporation (TSXV: RUSH)
snippet: Carolina Rush Corporation (TSXV: RUSH) announced on August 11, 2026 the execution of nine new mineral lease agreements totalling 2,524 acres adjacent to the west and northwest of its Brewer Gold-Copper Project in Chesterfield County, South Carolina, expanding the Jefferson Project's total landholding. The Brewer Project sits in the Carolina Slate Belt — the same Precambrian terrane that hosts multiple historic gold and copper-gold deposits along the Eastern Seaboard — and the adjacent Brewer Mine has prior gold-copper production history. Land package consolidation ahead of a drill program is a standard derisking step for South Carolina projects, where permitting timelines are long and land control is the gating constraint on exploration. Carolina Rush is one of a small number of TSX-V companies targeting gold-copper mineralization in the U.S. Southeast, a jurisdiction with growing political support for domestic critical mineral development under the Trump administration's supply chain priorities.
